entries.zh: 筛米（用筛箩筛米，扬去糠秕杂物）
entries.en: to sift rice (winnow away husks and chaff)

entries.zh: 簸米；扬米（另说：笞击米使之脱粒）
entries.en: to winnow rice; to thresh/beat rice
entries.notes: 汉字'笞'疑为'簸/箕'之类字形误读，同词头重复出现当为筛米之另一说法，据西语 ahechar 及闽音 chā 推断。

entries.zh: 契子；教子（受洗或拜认的义子，教父教母所认之子）
entries.en: godson; adopted/nominal son (one taken as son by compadrazgo)

entries.zh: 沦亡（沉沦灭亡；溺亡丧命）
entries.en: to perish, drown and die; be lost

entries.zh: 翕（掩覆；闭气窒闷，捂住使人透不过气）
entries.en: to cover/close over; to smother (stop the breath)
to stop up the mouth (nose), smothering the breath

entries.zh: 翕死人（掩闭窒死，把人捂死）
entries.en: to smother a person to death
to drown/overwhelm (cutting off the breath with water)

entries.zh: 噎死（喉塞气绝而死；按汉字'澂'疑为'噎/哽'之形讹）
entries.en: to choke to death (be strangled by obstruction of the throat)
entries.notes: 闽音 quiêc sí 与汉字'澂'（澄水义）不合，而西语 ahogarse 兼有'噎塞'义，推断字为'噎/哽'之形误。

entries.zh: 愠死了；郁结而死（气闷胸结以致丧命，即 AHOGARSE=ANEGARSE 溺闷而死）
entries.en: to suffocate/be stifled to death (ahogarse, i.e. anegarse: to drown)
entries.notes: 汉字'慍'取'郁怒气结'义以配 ahogar=sofocar（窒闷）一系义项；q̃=quasi 缩写展开依赖推断。
